title: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose the student union of your university is organizing an online discussion on interpersonal relationships. You are to write an essay on ways to maintain a warm and friendly relationship with your classmates and on the benefits of such a relationship. You will have 30 minutes f or the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words .
reference: A warm and friendly relationship plays an important part in our campus life. Since we spend most of our time with classmates, it is worth thinking about how to maintain such a relationship and what benefits it can bring. There are several practical ways to keep such a relationship close. First, we should communicate sincerely. For example, when a misunderstanding happens, we can simply talk it over honestly instead of staying cold. Besides, it also helps to support each other in study and daily life. When a classmate misses a lecture, sharing our notes and showing respect for different habits can quickly bring us closer. As a result, such a relationship can bring us real benefits. It eases our pressure when courses get hard, pushes us to make progress together, and creates a strong sense of belonging in class. In short, building such warm bonds with our classmates is well worth our effort throughout the precious college years.
keyPoints: 引题并亮双任务。首段用 plays an important part 落实『陈述重要性』句架，再用 how to maintain such a relationship and what benefits it can bring 把题目的『做法＋好处』两个任务一并 引出，开门见山、方向明确，达成了 outline 第一段『引入并亮中心』的功能。
分点举例写做法。主体段用 First / Besides 分出真诚沟通、互助尊重两条做法，并各配一个 场景——talk it over honestly 与 sharing our notes，把抽象的友好写实，落实了『分点＋举例展开』 方法，回应了 ways to maintain a warm and friendly relationship with your classmates。
因果收束写好处。尾段以 As a result 承接前段做法，列出 eases our pressure、make progress together、sense of belonging 三项好处，再用 In short 重申中心，落实『因果收束法』，回 应了 the benefits of such a relationship。
